description: Essential home maintenance tasks, schedules, and repair knowledge

monthly: Test smoke and carbon monoxide detectors
Flush water heater sediment (every few months)
seasonal_spring: Service HVAC system; replace air filters
seasonal_fall: Shut off and drain exterior faucets
Insulate exposed pipes in unheated areas
annual: Inspect attic for pests and moisture

plumbing_basics.main_shutoff: Know location to stop all water in emergencies
plumbing_basics.unclogging_drain: Plunger first; then drain snake; avoid chemical drain cleaners on older pipes
plumbing_basics.leaky_faucet: Usually worn washer or O-ring; shut off valve under sink; disassemble and replace
plumbing_basics.running_toilet: Usually flapper or fill valve; inexpensive parts; DIY-friendly
plumbing_basics.pipe_insulation: Wrap exposed pipes in cold areas to prevent freezing
plumbing_basics.water_heater_temp: Set at 49°C (120°F) to prevent scalding and save energy

electrical_basics.circuit_breaker: Reset by switching fully off then on; if repeatedly trips, call electrician
electrical_basics.gfci_outlets: Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter; required near water; test monthly with test button
electrical_basics.replacing_outlet: Turn off breaker; test with voltage tester; connect black to brass, white to silver, green/bare to green

light_bulbs.led: Most efficient; lasts 15,000–25,000 hours; low heat

hvac.duct_sealing: Seal leaks with mastic or metal tape; improves efficiency 20–30%
hvac.furnace_maintenance: Annual professional service; clean burners, check heat exchanger
hvac.ac_maintenance: Clean condenser coils; clear 2-foot radius around unit

painting.preparation: Clean, sand, and prime surfaces; tape edges; cover floors
painting.primer: Required for new drywall, drastic color changes, stains

finishes.flat_matte: Low sheen; hides imperfections; hard to clean
finishes.semi_gloss: High sheen; trim, doors, high-moisture areas

painting.technique: Cut in edges first; roll in W pattern; two coats typical
